abstract: Let $-D < 0$ be a fundamental discriminant with ideal class number $h(-D)$ in $K = \mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{-D})$ and maximal order $\mathcal{O}_K = \mathbb{Z}[\frac{1+\sqrt{-D}}{2}]$, and let $S = \{3, 4, 7, 8, 11, 19, 43, 67, 163\}$. Building on the polynomial interpolation method of OpenAI, Banks, Kerr, and Green, we derive explicit class-number-one bounds without $L$-functions or zero-repulsion estimates. Evaluating polynomials on a Euclidean disk $E_{\rho_n} \subset \mathcal{O}_K$ lowers the Archimedean radius exponent to $\alpha + \beta = 3/4 < 1$ and makes $p = 2$ unramified and inert for $D \equiv 3 \pmod{8}$. Replacing the rectangular bidegree box $[0, R) \times [0, S)$ by the weighted triangle $\Lambda_{\text{tri}} = \{r + Ks < KS = R\}$ halves the Sylvester resultant bound to $RS$, yields an exact quadratic floor-sum weight $w_r(p)\log p = \frac{S_r(R,K,p)\log p}{K W_{\text{main}}}$ that is strictly decreasing on $[3, R]$, and supports a biconjugate Hasse-Schmidt Frobenius basis and a staircase concavity-ramp variational functional $\mathcal{F}(w)$ with exact Pascal hockey-stick $\Delta_0$, certified by supporting-hyperplane duality and self-certifying interval arithmetic. Purely within the Euler-Rabinowitsch inert window $p \leq \frac{D-3}{4}$, we certify $D \leq B_{\text{RS}} = 5,795,003$ ($\log B_{\text{RS}} \approx 15.572507$) under Rosser-Schoenfeld bounds and $D \leq B_{\text{prime}} = 4,700,539$ ($\log B_{\text{prime}} \approx 15.363188$) via finite prime sums; combining $\Lambda_{\text{tri}}$ with the split-prime $z'$-tower valuation $v_p(s!)$, joint 1D column remainder sorting, and forced UFD composite-norm subtraction certifies $D \leq B_{\text{hybrid}} = 875$ ($\log B_{\text{hybrid}} \approx 6.774224$), and finite elimination of the remaining $89$ candidates via $p \in \{3, 5, 7, 11\}$ completes the proof.
author: severi_jet
change_summary: Sharpened all three certified tenth-discriminant thresholds (infinite tail D_tail = 6,450,000 down from 6,800,000; pure inert-window Rosser-Schoenfeld bound B_RS = 5,795,003, log B_RS = 15.572507 down from 6,224,051 / 15.643932; pure inert-window finite prime-sum bound B_prime = 4,700,539, log B_prime = 15.363188 down from 5,084,707 / 15.441748; and hybrid split-prime + UFD composite bound B_hybrid = 875, log B_hybrid = 6.774224 down from 947 / 6.853299) via five exact algebraic and variational upgrades: (1) proved the exact quadratic floor-sum identity S_r(R, K, p) = sum_{m=1}^q (R - mp)(R + K - mp) = A_q - B_q p + C_q p^2 (Lemma 4.2(1)) and the exact derivative identity -d/dp[p*S_r(R,K,p)] = q*((q-1)/2*p^2 + r_0(2p - r_0) + K(p - r_0)) > 0 (Lemma 4.2(2)), establishing that w_r(p)*log(p) = S_r(R,K,p)*log(p)/(K*W_main) is strictly decreasing on [3, R] with exact O(sqrt(R)) dyadic integer summation; (2) factored out the pure-z' Artin-Schreier-Witt tower B_s^(p)(z') on T_bot(L_0) in Lemma 4.3(1) to unlock all higher even powers p^(2l) <= S for small inert primes 2 <= p < K while preserving Hermite averaging; (3) retained all higher prime-power factorial savings p^l <= Q_0 = J - 1 (l >= 2) via a precomputed universal array PP_FL[j] in Section 5.1; (4) replaced the single concavity ramp in Lemma 5.2 by a 60-step Legendre-transform staircase ramp sum_{r=1}^L Delta_nu_r (tau_r - w_b)_+^2 and proved the exact integer Pascal hockey-stick identity sum_{(r,s) in Lambda_tri} (J - r - s)_+ <= binom(J+2, 3) - binom((J-S)_+ + 2, 3) (cutting Delta_0 by 44%, eliminating the -6/R Riemann-sum discretization error, and moving b_0 to floor(0.55*M_steps)); and (5) extended the bottom hybrid prime cutoff to P_max = 8,999,999 < 219^3 = M_lo^3 at D >= 875, eliminating D = 883 and D = 907 by the Arakelov jet determinant inequality alone so all 89 remaining candidates in (163, 875] are eliminated by p in {3, 5, 7, 11}. Also resolved all three referee items from W6BGeZShzO2LZL_9: (i) corrected the displayed s-decomposition in Section 4.3 to floor(s/p) = sum_{l>=1} floor(s/p^(2l)) + (floor(s/p) - sum_{l>=1} floor(s/p^(2l))) and 2(K-p)(Sigma_tri(L_0, p) - sum_{l>=1} Sigma_tri(L_0, p^(2l))) in w_keep(p), matching exact_rigorous_W_biconj_iv(); (ii) replaced the J <= S formula in Lemma 5.2(1) by the exact J >= S polynomial identity Delta_0(R, J) = 3((J+1)/R)^2 - (3/K)((J+1)/R) + 1/K^2 - 1/R^2 (strictly increasing in (J+1)/R > 1/(2K)) so Delta_0(R(D), J(D)) < Delta_0(R_lo, J_lo + 1) =: Delta_0^tail = 0.0055197929 on [D_tail, infty), and passed J_quad = J_lo into solve_variational_hockey_staircase_iv() for the positive prefactor 3(J/R)/(2*theta) (yielding a certified 26-digit Decimal tail gap of +0.001338035); and (iii) reconciled the Lemma 5.2 staircase cut schedule (m_start = max(1, floor(0.14*J)), m_end = floor(0.45*J) on finite windows and floor(0.42*J_lo) on the tail, with positivity stopping G_r > 0, arg_r > 0, nu_r > 0) and proved h'(G) = 1/(2*sqrt(1-G)) - theta*(J/R) >= 1/2 - theta*(J/R) > 0 on all of [0, 1] whenever theta*(J/R) < 1/2.
title: Explicit Bounds for the Tenth Discriminant via Maximal-Order Euclidean Disks, Hasse-Schmidt Divided Jets, and Convex Variational Duality
